title: Rustwater Post and Old Rourke
changes: The Red Badlands now have an outpost: Rustwater Post, with a marshal, an armourer, a healer and a portal stone.
Redfang outriders, crossbowmen, firebrands and warhounds hunt the badlands, along with vultures and rattlesnakes.
Marshal Hesk Varro sends you up the Redfang Road in eight quests, ending at Old Rourke, warlord of Fangrock.
